goal: Every inter-flywheel dependency in the downstream packages' pyproject.toml carries a real version constraint, so a built wheel's Requires-Dist resolves from artifact metadata alone, while the in-repo workspace install and the one-way dependency arrow are unchanged.

graders.name: downstream-metadata-is-versioned
graders.run:
set -e; D=$(mktemp -d); uv build --all-packages --out-dir "$D" >/dev/null 2>&1; python3 - "$D" <<'PY'
import sys, zipfile, glob, re, os
dist = sys.argv[1]
inter = {"flywheel-core", "flywheel-orchestrator", "flywheel-worktree", "flywheel"}
spec = re.compile(r"[<>=~!]=?")
wheels = glob.glob(os.path.join(dist, "*.whl"))
assert wheels, "no wheels built"
checked = 0
for whl in wheels:
    z = zipfile.ZipFile(whl)
    meta = next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith(".dist-info/METADATA"))
    for line in z.read(meta).decode().splitlines():
        if not line.startswith("Requires-Dist:"):
            continue
        body = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
        name = re.split(r"[\s\[;(]", body, 1)[0].strip()
        if name in inter:
            assert spec.search(body), f"{os.path.basename(whl)}: unversioned inter-flywheel dep -> {line!r}"
            checked += 1
assert checked >= 3, f"expected >=3 versioned inter-flywheel Requires-Dist lines across the downstream wheels, saw {checked}"
print("OK versioned inter-flywheel deps:", checked)
PY
rc=$?; rm -rf "$D"; exit $rc

graders.name: core-declares-no-downstream-dep
graders.run:
set -e; D=$(mktemp -d); uv build --package flywheel-core --out-dir "$D" >/dev/null 2>&1; python3 - "$D" <<'PY'
import sys, zipfile, glob, os
dist = sys.argv[1]
banned = {"flywheel-orchestrator", "flywheel-worktree", "flywheel"}
whl = glob.glob(os.path.join(dist, "flywheel_core-*.whl"))[0]
z = zipfile.ZipFile(whl)
meta = next(n for n in z.namelist() if n.endswith(".dist-info/METADATA"))
for line in z.read(meta).decode().splitlines():
    if line.startswith("Requires-Dist:"):
        body = line.split(":", 1)[1].strip()
        name = body.split(" ")[0].split("[")[0].split(";")[0].strip()
        assert name not in banned, f"core wheel back-points at a downstream package: {line!r}"
print("OK core declares no downstream flywheel dependency")
PY
rc=$?; rm -rf "$D"; exit $rc

graders.name: verification-surface-review
graders.instruction: Held-out gate (criterion #10). Diff the test changes. For every assertion removed, relaxed, or skipped in any existing test -- especially packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_task_module_purity.py, test_lifecycle_module_purity.py, test_sdk_optional.py, and any test asserting the one-way dependency arrow or core-without-SDK invariant -- confirm a named replacement check of equal-or-greater strength is present. A dropped or weakened purity / arrow / SDK-optional guard under cover of this packaging change, with no equal replacement, is a blocking defect: reject.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00029-FEATURE-distributable-install.md -- authoritative spec; criteria #5, #6, #7, #8, #9, #10 and Decomposition Hint Layer A
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/pyproject.toml -- depends on flywheel-core (currently unversioned); add a version constraint
packages/flywheel-worktree/pyproject.toml -- depends on flywheel-orchestrator (currently unversioned); add a version constraint
packages/flywheel/pyproject.toml -- depends on flywheel-core[claude], flywheel-orchestrator, flywheel-worktree (all currently unversioned); add version constraints, preserve the [claude] extra marker
packages/flywheel-core/pyproject.toml -- declares NO downstream dependency today; it must stay that way (criterion #7). Its [claude]/[postgres] optional extras must remain optional.
pyproject.toml -- the root [tool.uv.sources] { workspace = true } table; it MUST remain so uv sync keeps resolving locally (criterion #8)
packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_sdk_optional.py -- keep green; proves import flywheel_core works with no claude-agent-sdk (criterion #6)
references: All four packages are currently version 0.1.0. Pick ONE constraint style and apply it consistently across the three downstream pyprojects (the spec's shared-invariant note: name the style once here so Layer B/C inherit it). A constraint that the workspace source table can still satisfy on a routine version bump is required -- an over-tight pin that breaks uv sync fails the in-repo-uv-sync grader.
uv_build already ships non-.py package data (_schema/*.sql, _skill_templates/*.md, py.typed) by default; this task does NOT touch package-data globs -- only the dependency version constraints.
constraints: Add a non-empty version specifier to every inter-flywheel Requires-Dist edge in the three downstream packages so the foreign install graph resolves from wheel METADATA alone (criterion #5).
Keep the root [tool.uv.sources] { workspace = true } table intact: uv sync from this checkout must still install all four packages and uv run flywheel --help must exit 0 (criterion #8).
Do not add any dependency from flywheel-core onto a downstream package; the one-way arrow stays (criterion #7).
Do not make claude-agent-sdk a hard dependency of flywheel-core; it stays the optional [claude] extra (criterion #6).
Commit the change with a clear conventional-commit message before reporting done; no emojis.
non_goals: Do not author, edit, weaken, delete, or read anything under .flywheel/holdout/00029-distributable-install/ -- that fenced held-out grading surface is authored separately.
Do not modify, weaken, skip, or delete any assertion in packages/*/tests/ -- especially the *_module_purity.py tests, test_sdk_optional.py, or any one-way-arrow guard.
Do not add a build/publish helper or any foreign-install script here -- that is the dependent dist-foreign-install task.
Do not change cwd/git-toplevel path-resolution logic, package-data globs, or the build backend.
Do not pin exact versions so tight that a routine workspace version bump can no longer be satisfied by [tool.uv.sources].
edge_cases: A bare unversioned Requires-Dist (just the package name, no specifier) must fail the downstream-metadata-is-versioned grader -- the whole point of criterion #5.

A constraint that breaks uv sync (e.g. an exact ==X.Y.Z that the dirty workspace tree cannot match) must fail the in-repo-uv-sync grader -- criterion #8 forecloses fixing the foreign path by breaking the dev path.
